query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chapterOutlines` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `blueprintId` int NOT NULL,
  `outline` json NOT NULL,
  `approved` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `chapterOutlines_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chapterOutlines_blueprintId_storyBlueprints_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`blueprintId`) REFERENCES `storyBlueprints`(`id`) ON DELETE cascade ON UPDATE no action
);
